objective.text: Distinguish accepting JSON responses from choosing JSON request encoding.

difficulty.rationale: Keep desired response format independent of submitted body format.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: What formats does this request ask for and send?

options.text: It asks for a form response and sends a JSON body.
options.rationale: This reverses the roles of acceptJson and asForm.
options.misconception: This reverses the roles of acceptJson and asForm.

options.text: It sends JSON because acceptJson overrides asForm.
options.rationale: A response preference does not replace the form body format.
options.misconception: A response preference does not replace the form body format.

options.text: It asks for a JSON response and sends a form-encoded body.
options.rationale: Accept and request Content-Type serve different directions; these calls configure each independently.

options.text: It sends multipart data because all non-JSON POST bodies use multipart.
options.rationale: URL-encoded form bodies are distinct from multipart uploads.
options.misconception: URL-encoded form bodies are distinct from multipart uploads.
